text.en:
Increased Flinch on Enemies.

<pve [PVE] Allows Primary Weapons to affect higher ranked enemies and consistently stunlock Minors. />

<pvp [PVP] Flinch amount against Guardians varies between Weapon Archetypes, from 6% to 11% Increased Flinch received. />
text.zh-chs:
命中后增加敌人的后仰抖动。

<pve [PVE] 允许主武器作用于高阶敌人，并可使低阶普通敌人持续晕眩。 />

<pvp [PVP] 根据武器框架不同，增加敌方守护者 6% 至 11% 的后仰抖动，/>
